messages:
clare-h: Heads up — after last night's RBAC migration we started seeing a spike in SCIM deprovision retries for a few tenants and a concurrent gap in audit events for service_account.role changes :eyes:

clare-h: Symptoms: SCIM queue repeats deprov attempts, users unable to complete SSO, and audit-db shows missing events in the same window. Auth-proxy logs show saml validation failures.

clare-h: Sample from auth-proxy logs:
```
WARN  svc-provisioner: scim: deprov retry tenant=acme svc_acc=sa-analytics cause="assertion validation failed"
ERROR idp-validate: saml: binding mismatch expected="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" got="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Artifact"
audit: missing event id=0x7fa23 for tenant=acme action=service_account.update
```

raj-p: Two quick hypotheses: (A) IdP metadata changed binding to Artifact and our SP was tightened to only accept POST during RBAC rollout, or (B) KMS envelope key rotated leaving stale wrap alias in token-store causing signature/resolve failures.

raj-p: Quick checks:
```
# check SP metadata
curl -s https://auth-proxy.internal/.well-known/saml-metadata | grep -i Binding
# check token-wrap alias
kubectl exec -n infra deploy/provisioner -- redis-cli HGET token:wrap-key current_alias
```

kevin-m: I pulled Okta metadata for that tenant — they now advertise HTTP-Artifact only. We used to accept both; RBAC change set auth-proxy to strict POST-only. That explains assertion failures -> SCIM thinks auth revoked -> deprovs.

david-l: Audit shipper logs show a restart during the rotation window, looks like truncation so some events weren't flushed. grep showing SIGTERM at 1694456000.

clare-h: So two concurrent failures: IdP binding mismatch + audit-shipper interruption. Plan: add temporary artifact tolerance in auth-proxy (tenant-gated), backfill missing audit events, requeue deprovs, and verify KMS token aliases.

kevin-m: Proposed hotfix: config enable_artifact_fallback=true, tenant whitelist. I'll open a minimal PR and canary it.

raj-p: I'll run token-store/KMS sanity: list wrap aliases and check for dangling references; if found we'll unwrap/rewrap impacted tokens and rotate consumers.

oncall: Opening incident ticket and running mitigations now. Commands I'm running:
```
./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant acme --since 1694450000
./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1694450000 --end 1694460000 --verify
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n infra
```

sso-bot: Deploy 2024.1.9-hotfix (auth-proxy) queued; auto-promote to canary after health checks :white_check_mark:.

clare-h: Ownership: I own backfill & requeue. Raj owns KMS/token-store checks. Kevin owns auth-proxy patch + canary. David, add an audit-shipper hardening runbook item to avoid flush-loss on restart. Oncall coordinate timeline + customer comms. Ping here with results and we'll schedule a postmortem after stabilization. :thumbsup:
